The '''Tromper Crags White Maw base''' was a base built by the [[White Maw]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] in the cliffs south of the [[Snow Hills Pass]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. Though it was named for the [[Tromper Crags]], the Crags themselves were located to the west in the [[Highmount Ridge]]. [[Shai Tenna]] used it as his base of operations.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Tromper Crags White Maw base appears in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', where it is the location of the Smuggler class mission "Brotherhood" on Hoth.<ref name="TOR" />
